privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Which data we collect and how we use it.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body: The controller is **Vito Strisciuglio**, trading as Flow Digital Lab, based in Bari (Puglia, Italy).
sections.footer: For any request about your data, write to **info@flowdigitallab.it**.

sections.heading: 2. Which data we process and why
sections.body: We only process data you give us or that the site records in order to work:
list: **Messages from the form or WhatsApp:** name, email and the text of your message. We use them to reply and prepare a quote. Legal basis: pre-contractual steps you request (Art. 6.1.b GDPR). We keep them for 24 months after the last contact. If a contract starts, we keep them for its duration and then for 10 years for tax obligations.

**Technical browsing data:** IP address and requests recorded in the hosting provider's logs. They keep the site secure and working. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.f GDPR). The provider keeps them for the period set in its own policy.
sections.footer: Providing the form data is optional. Without name, email and message we cannot reply. We do not use your data for advertising and we do not make automated decisions.

sections.heading: 3. Who we share data with
sections.body: We use providers that process data on our behalf:
list: **Vercel Inc.:** site hosting.
**Resend:** sending the contact form emails.
**Meta (WhatsApp):** only if you message us on WhatsApp, under their privacy notice.
sections.footer: Some providers are based in the United States. Transfers use the safeguards the GDPR provides: the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. **We do not sell your data.**

sections.heading: 4. Security
sections.body: The site uses an HTTPS connection. Messages arrive in the controller's email inbox and only the controller can access it.

sections.heading: 5. Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679) you can exercise these rights:
list: **Access:** receive a copy of your data.
**Rectification:** correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
**Erasure:** ask us to delete your data.
**Restriction:** ask us to pause processing.
**Portability:** receive your data in a structured format.
**Objection:** object to processing based on legitimate interest.
sections.footer: Write to info@flowdigitallab.it. We reply within 30 days. You can also lodge a complaint with the **Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante)** (garanteprivacy.it).

terms.title: Terms &
terms.subtitle: The rules that apply to our services.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are and how a contract starts
sections.body: The site belongs to **Vito Strisciuglio**, trading as Flow Digital Lab, based in Bari. The site presents our services for information. A contract starts when you accept the quote in writing.
sections.footer: We may update these terms. Changes apply from the date they are published and do not alter quotes already accepted.

sections.heading: 2. Services
list: **Websites:** design and development of showcase sites and online shops.
**Brand identity:** logo, palette, typography and usage guide.
**Digital strategy:** a plan for channels, content and metrics.
sections.footer: The quote sets out the details of each project and forms part of the contract.

sections.heading: 3. Payments and invoicing
list: **Deposit:** 50% of the amount at the start of the project.
**Balance:** the remaining 50% on delivery.
**Methods:** bank transfer, PayPal or credit card.
**Invoicing:** we issue an electronic invoice for each payment. Payment terms are stated on the invoice.
sections.footer: Prices exclude VAT unless stated otherwise.

sections.heading: 4. Revisions and changes
sections.body: The quote includes two design revision rounds. Extra revisions are quoted separately.
sections.footer: Substantial changes after approval can change costs and delivery times.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual property
sections.body: **Before the balance:** the materials produced remain Flow Digital Lab's property.
sections.footer: **After the balance:** the client owns the agreed deliverables in full, including source files, graphics and code. Third-party components and open-source software stay under their own licence. We may show the work in our portfolio. The client's name and logo appear only with their consent, unless a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) applies.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of liability
sections.body: Flow Digital Lab is not liable for:
list: Indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the services.
Problems with third-party services, such as hosting and domain.
Delays caused by late feedback or lack of cooperation from the client.
sections.footer: Maximum liability is limited to the amount paid for the project. This clause also appears in the quote and needs your specific written approval. If you are a consumer, your mandatory rights under the Italian Consumer Code remain valid.

sections.heading: 7. Governing law and jurisdiction
sections.body: These terms follow Italian law. The Court of Bari has jurisdiction over disputes. If you are a consumer, the court of your domicile has jurisdiction.

cookie.title: Cookie
cookie.subtitle: This site does not set cookies.

sections.heading: 1. What we use
sections.body: The site does not set cookies. It saves one piece of information in your browser:
list: **Theme preference (localStorage):** remembers the light or dark theme you choose. It stays on your device and is not sent to us. You can delete it from your browser settings.
sections.footer: It is a technical tool tied to a choice you make, so it does not need your consent (Art. 122 Italian Privacy Code).

sections.heading: 2. What we do not use
list: Analytics or statistics cookies.
Profiling or advertising cookies.
Social network pixels.
Third-party cookies.
sections.footer: If we add them in future, we will ask for your consent before enabling them and update this page.

sections.heading: 3. Links to other services
sections.body: The site links to WhatsApp, Instagram and GitHub. If you click them you leave this site and those services' notices apply, which may use their own cookies.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: It depends on pages, features and content. After a first call we send a free quote with costs and timing. You pay 50% at the start and 50% on delivery.
It depends on the project. After the call, the delivery date is written in the quote.
We measure results and fix what needs fixing. The support included is listed in the quote.

items.q: Can I update the content myself?
items.a: Yes. At delivery we show you how to edit text and images, and the quote states how you will manage content.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside my city?
items.a: Yes, we work remotely across Italy.
